podcast.title: Death Details - November 18, 2024
podcast.body: Colin Petersen died on November 18th, 2024. "And then on November 18th, Colin Peterson, the original drummer for the Bee Gees back in the 1960s also died."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Colin Petersen was the original drummer for the Bee Gees during the 1960s. "Colin Peterson, the original drummer for the Bee Gees back in the 1960s also died."
